name: Menethil Harbor
summary: Menethil Harbor links the Eastern Kingdoms to Kalimdor from its island off the Wetlands' western shore. Stone battlements and Menethil Keep's towers guard the port, where merchants, off-duty soldiers, and salty adventurers gather.

sections.title: A Fortified Haven
sections.body: Menethil Harbor honors King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron and offers the Alliance a haven on the Wetlands coast. Its remote marshland setting leaves it exposed, so massive walls, a single bridged causeway, and Menethil Keep's four stone watchtowers guard the town.

sections.title: Gateway Across the Great Sea
sections.body: Menethil Harbor is a crossroads for Alliance ships crossing the ocean to Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh and, by way of Southshore, Auberdine in Darkshore. The ships carry trade and diplomats, while off-duty Kul Tiran marines spend their wages at the Deepwater Tavern. Peace remains fragile. The Dragonmaw clan contests inland supply paths through Dun Algaz, and Dark Iron raiders press the northern marshes. Captain Stoutfist and the harbor garrison stay on constant alert.

faq.q: Where do the ships in Menethil Harbor sail to?
faq.answer: Ships from Menethil Harbor cross the Great Sea to Kalimdor. Passenger vessels sail regularly to Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh, then north to Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills and onward to the night elven haven of Auberdine.

aliases: who is in charge of menethil
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor is an Alliance settlement under Ironforge's authority. Captain Stoutfist commands the town guard and directs harbor defense from Menethil Keep, keeping the docks secure from swamp beasts, renegade orcs, and inland raiders.

faq.q: Why is the town named Menethil?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor was named for King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron. His leadership united the human, dwarven, and elven realms into the original Alliance of Lordaeron.

faq.q: What threats does the harbor face right now?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw clan lurks in the Wetlands hills and regularly tries to cut off the pass through Dun Algaz, starving the port of reinforcements. Dark Iron incursions to the north near Dun Modr and marauding raptors add to the garrison's troubles.

angles.text: For an Alliance traveler heading west, Menethil Harbor is a vital staging ground and the sole maritime bridge linking the Eastern Kingdoms to Theramore.
As a dwarf, you can see your people's stonework throughout this port, though it bears a human king's name. Dwarves man the Ironforge guards who hold Khaz Modan's outer threshold.
